correctness.rationale: Explicit formula across all three parameter intervals was independently checked with exact rational arithmetic for d=2,…,24 and representative rational h including h=d and both sides of transitions: (c,a²,b²)=(0,d,d) if 1<h≤√d, (0,h²,(d−1)h²/(h²−1)) if √d≤h≤d, and ((h−d)/(d+1),d²(h+1)²/(d+1)²,d²/(d+1)) if h≥d. Every cube vertex and apex lies in the ellipsoid by direct quadratic substitution; exact contacts follow by strict convexity and the strict gap for positive-face vertices when h>d. Global minimality is not inferred from symmetry: for each regime the source constructs an actual contact probability with mean ce1 and covariance diag(a²,b²,…,b²)/d. Verified the apex weights and transverse variance identities symbolically/exactly. Upon affine normalization, the contact measure has E[Z]=0 and E[ZZᵀ]=I/d; for any containing translated ellipsoid w+TB, E||T⁻¹(Z−w)||²≤1 implies tr(T⁻²)≤d and det T≥1 by AM–GM, equality only T=I and w=0. This certifies uniqueness against arbitrary translated, rotated ellipsoids. The volume limit for h_d/√d→τ is obtained by elementary log expansion, with τ=1 handled continuously.
